On October 15, with the help of independent security researchers, we identified and resolved a vulnerability affecting a third-party integration on the ChangeNOW website.

ChangeNOW’s transaction infrastructure was not affected, and client funds were secure throughout.

We currently have no evidence that it was exploited. But we also can’t assume that the researchers who reported it were the only ones to find it. Because of that, we’re looking at the different scenarios and warning clients about the information that could potentially have been exposed. This may include email addresses and transaction details.

For now, the main thing clients should watch out for is phishing. Always verify the sender of unexpected messages, avoid suspicious links, and never share your passwords, private keys, or seed phrases. Our official support email is support@changenow.io.

We’re launching NOW AI, a security initiative focused on identifying vulnerabilities earlier, and strengthening protection across all ChangeNOW products.

Today's discovery has accelerated its launch. More details on NOW AI will be published soon on a dedicated page on the ChangeNOW website.
